device_entry.name: 多比特量子控制与读出系统
device_entry.name_en: Multi-qubit Quantum Control and Readout System
tags: 量子比特脉冲控制与读出
瞬态信号采集与同步触发测量
device_entry.description: 用于超导量子比特实验的组合式电子测控系统，协同任意波形发生器、数字时序控制器、通量控制链路和积分采集读出设备，对多个量子比特进行时序对齐、通量脉冲控制与读出测量。常用于时域实验、单次读出、相关性测量和系统标定。
device_entry.description_en: A composite electronic control and measurement system for superconducting qubit experiments. It coordinates waveform generators, digital timing controllers, flux-control lines, and integrated readout hardware to align timing, apply flux pulses, and perform qubit readout across multiple qubits. It is commonly used for time-domain experiments, single-shot readout, correlation measurements, and calibration.

schema.description: 配置控制与读出通道的延迟和触发时序，使多台量子测控设备精确对齐。
schema.description_en: Configure delays and trigger timing for control and readout channels so multiple quantum-control instruments are precisely aligned.

schema.description: 为指定量子比特配置通量控制链路和相关脉冲设置。
schema.description_en: Configure the flux-control path and related pulse settings for the specified qubits.

schema.description_en: Configure the readout path, acquisition channels, and integration settings for the specified qubits.
